what_happened: Scene: layout 6 (brown wood cabinets, speckled granite), pan_4 (black non-stick pan, black handle) in an upper cabinet above a toaster oven; target rear_left burner 1.66 m away; chicken drumstick 2.1 m from the burner. Stage 0: 128-178 the gripper was at the handle near the pan body, with the handle running diagonally/horizontally across the bottom of the wrist image (along the finger-closing axis, not between the fingers). It closed at 169 touching the pan (width 0.006): nothing was enclosed and the fingers stayed closed. From ~190 to 2900 the arm hovered 20-60 cm in front of the pan with the fingers closed (wrist keeps the whole pan in view at 300-2896), with closes on air at 352 and 1024 and two brief nudges of the pan (1349-1361, 1580; no lift). It never reopened the gripper for a new grasp, never went to the stove or the drumstick, and no knob moved.
causal_chain: handle presented along the finger-closing axis -> close at 169 enclosed nothing -> fingers stayed closed and the arm hovered in front of the pan for ~2700 steps -> pan never left the cabinet -> timeout
self_recovery: none effective: re-approached a few times (1349, 1580) with closed fingers.

packet_facts: close 169 on pan width 0.006; closes 352, 1024 on air
